tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0027, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0028 1. Lemma 1.20\group so3-isotropy

If $(A_0,B_0,C_0)_\varepsilon $ is a family of initial data parameterized by $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$ such that $\lim _{\varepsilon \to 0}F(0,\varepsilon )>0$, then for all $t\in (0,T_0)$, $\lim _{\varepsilon \to 0}F(t,\varepsilon )=0$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0027, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0028 \sketch The evolution equation for $F$ has a negative term of size $Q/\varepsilon $ dominating the positive part uniformly on compact time intervals, so $F(t,\varepsilon )$ is forced to zero as $\varepsilon \searrow 0$.

□
